text:
Alice (Sales): Kickoff: ACME wants to expand the trial to include BYO-KMS + reranking. Need quick alignment on success criteria and timeline. @Jamie can you outline what's required? cc @Ravi
Jamie (SE): Quick Q — is ACME insisting on full on-prem Private deployment or is VPC peering + BYO-KMS enough for the trial? That changes lead time.
Morgan (Customer PM): We can start with VPC peering + customer-managed KMS for the trial. Long-term they may go full on-prem but for evaluation 6 weeks is the goal.
Taylor (AE): Heads up: VPC + BYO-KMS is classified as a Private trial in pricing — infra setup fee applies. I'll follow up with numbers.
Jamie (SE): Proposal for success criteria: (a) end-to-end p95 latency < 250ms for 512-token gen, (b) embeddings recall@10 >= 0.88 on their eval set, (c) hallucination rate < 3% from manual sample, (d) cost per 1M tokens < $400 with recommended batching/quantization. Agree / adjustments?
Ravi (Security): KMS integration: need key wrapping and centralized audit logs. Legal will likely ask for FIPS HSM for prod keys. For trial we can accept cloud KMS, but note the request. @Morgan confirm legal stance.
Morgan (Customer PM): Legal prefers option for FIPS HSM in prod but not mandatory for trial. We want the toggle later, not now.
Jamie (SE): We can support switching KMS later but full on-prem packaging + security review adds ~3–4 weeks. VPC-peering + BYO-KMS is ~1–2 weeks to stand up.
Alice (Sales): Can you add a minimal eval harness we can run against their sample queries and docs? They asked for reproducible checks to sign off.
Jamie (SE): Putting together a quick harness — use Redwood hosted endpoints for the trial run. Example perf / functional snippets below:
```bash
# run perf eval against /v1/generate
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-8k","prompt":"<EVAL_PROMPT>","max_tokens":512,"stream":false}' | jq .
```
```python
# embedding recall test (pseudo)
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
emb = c.embeddings.create(model="rw-embed-4k", input=["doc1","query"])
# compute recall@10 vs ground_truth...
```
Taylor (AE): Pricing note: I'll prepare two quotes — Hosted trial (no infra fee, limited throughput) and Private VPC trial (infra setup fee ~$8k + monthly minimum). Sending numbers after this thread.
Morgan (Customer PM): Throughput goal: 50 QPS generation at 250ms p95 during peak. Can you confirm capacity assumptions?
Jamie (SE): 50 QPS at 250ms p95 is achievable on a Dedicated cluster with dynamic batching for their eval shape (avg seq 400). Recommend ~4x A100 equivalent. VPC trial may have slightly higher p95 due to network egress.
Ravi (Security): @Jamie ensure no model weights or artifacts leave the private subnet for on-prem. Also legal will require SOC2 evidence and a 30-day max retention for trial logs.
Jamie (SE): Ack. We'll enable audit logs and retention controls. Quick note on tradeoffs: int8 quantization reduces cost ~40% but can slightly increase hallucination/quality variance — we should A/B test.
Morgan (Customer PM): If quantization increases hallucination beyond our threshold, we prefer accuracy over cost for the trial. Success criteria > cost savings.
Alice (Sales): Change request: ACME added rerank and BYO-KMS to the trial — that changes scope. @Taylor please update the SOW and date estimates.
Taylor (AE): Estimate timeline: kickoff config by 2026-03-10, VPC peering + KMS setup by 2026-03-24, eval run complete by 2026-04-07. I'll circulate updated SOW EOD.
DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: vpc-peering-template v1.2 queued for customer-acme on 2026-03-12 02:15 UTC
Jamie (SE): For a reproducible hallucination metric: propose 200 manually curated prompts + automated NLI-based contradiction checks. I'll draft the eval checklist and share tomorrow.
Morgan (Customer PM): One last ask: ACME wants model fallback policy so if capacity constrains we can route to smaller model with lower latency. Can we include that in the trial?
Jamie (SE): Yes — routing policy available. We'll configure fallback to rw-instruct-3b. Note: outputs will change; we should add acceptance criteria for fallback behavior.
Alice (Sales): :thumbsup: I'll summarize and loop in Legal & Procurement after Jamie shares the checklist. Thanks all.
